title: Rogan's reading on Project Blue Book, Hynek, Corso and Roswell
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Rogan's reading on Project Blue Book, Hynek, Corso and Roswell, about 1947-1969 at Roswell, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I got really into Project Blue Book and I read a lot of the stuff on Jay Allen Heinik and you know and all the Philip Corso stuff and the stuff from Roswell

plain: A well-known podcast host, Joe Rogan, says he once got deeply into reading about Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and about J. Allen Hynek, the astronomer who worked on it. He also says he read the claims of Philip Corso, an Army officer who wrote about crashed alien technology, and material about Roswell, the 1947 New Mexico event said by some to involve a crashed saucer. He tells it to explain how his own interest in the subject began.
